User.title: Authorized User
User.description: Authorized user account with login credentials, roles, and real-time single-session tracking token.

userId.description: Unique username or ID used to login (case-insensitive key)

name.description: User display name / shop operator name

role.description: Access level of the user (admin can manage other user logins, operator can use app)

isAllowed.description: Admin allow/deny filter toggle. If false, user cannot login.

activeSessionToken.description: Unique UUID/token for current active login session. Changes on each login to force terminate simultaneous logins.

boundHardwareId.description: Bound PC MAC Address, CPU ID, or Hardware Identifier for PC-locking registration

isPcBindingEnabled.description: Whether PC-binding lock is strictly enforced for this operator

boundHardwareLabel.description: Optional friendly label for bound machine (e.g. Counter 1 Desktop)

boundAt.description: Timestamp when account was bound to the PC MAC/hardware ID

lastSeenHardwareId.description: Last detected hardware MAC / device ID on login attempt

lastLoginAt.description: Unix timestamp in ms of last successful login

lastActiveAt.description: Unix timestamp in ms of recent heartbeat ping

notes.description: Admin notes about operator or machine

SecurityConfig.title: Security Configuration
SecurityConfig.description: Global security settings like require login, strict single-session enforcement, etc.

requireLogin.description: Whether authentication is strictly enforced to use the app

allowSelfRegistration.description: Whether users can request access (pending admin approval)

/users/{userId}.description: Collection of authorized users keyed by normalized lowercased userId.

/system_config/{configId}.description: System security preferences and global toggles.
